kickoffPrompt: Work in DaveHomeAssist/system-by-dave from freshly verified remote main using the repository claim protocol. Read AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/av-suite-consolidation-spec.md and docs/av-suite-doorway.md. Implement the settled returning-neutral Toolbox rule while preserving explicit Show/context entry, pins, recents, saved show data and browser history. Update the paired responsive assertion and documentation. Validate, review, commit, push, merge under repository policy and verify deployment and live fresh/returning journeys. Follow with public Workbook withdrawal under the maintained scope; do not redesign Workbook or migrate its documents. Refresh the existing av-consolidation projection after verified evidence changes.
